name: Sino Land Company Limited
summary: Sino Land Company Limited, an investment holding company, invests in, develops, manages, and trades in properties in Hong Kong, Chinese Mainland, Singapore, and Australia. The company operates through Property Sales, Property Rental, Hotel Operations, Investments in Securities and Financing, and Property Management and Other Services segments. Its property portfolio includes shopping malls, offices, industrial buildings, residentials, and car parks.
